test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.**

Following in the footsteps of France, Italy has ______ (1) ______ a new tax to be ______ (2) ______ on large tech companies, a move that is likely to put more strain on the country's relations with the USA. The Italian parliament has approved a 3% digital tax on some digital revenue of technology companies that make over $831 million in global revenue, including at least $6 million in Italy. The tax ______ (3) ______ similar to the one France implemented earlier this year, which has attracted ______ (4) ______ criticism from the USA. According to a report in The Epoch Times, dozens of countries are working on proposals to change corporate tax schemes to ______ (5) ______ money from tech firms that have users across the world, such as Facebook and Google's parent company Alphabet.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"capture."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Capture'** means to take possession or control of something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या पशु को बंदी बनाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The lion was **captured**__ and taken back to the zoo.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about proposals to change corporate tax schemes to capture money from tech firms.
 
• Grammatically,** 'capture' **fits well with the preposition** 'to' **that follows it.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

Following in the footsteps of France, Italy has ______ (1) ______ a new tax to be ______ (2) ______ on large tech companies, a move that is likely to put more strain on the country's relations with the USA. The Italian parliament has approved a 3% digital tax on some digital revenue of technology companies that make over $831 million in global revenue, including at least $6 million in Italy. The tax ______ (3) ______ similar to the one France implemented earlier this year, which has attracted ______ (4) ______ criticism from the USA. According to a report in The Epoch Times, dozens of countries are working on proposals to change corporate tax schemes to __**capture**__ money from tech firms that have users across the world, such as Facebook and Google's parent company Alphabet.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (take**) also means to acquire or get hold of something, but it does not convey the idea of control or possession as strongly as 'capture'. (किसी को लेना या ले जाना; किसी के साथ कहीं जाना)
 
• **Option 2 (remove) **means to take away or eliminate something, which is not relevant in this context. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को हटा या मिटा देना)
 
• **Option 3 (seize) **means to take hold of something forcibly, which may not be an appropriate word choice in a business context. (किसी वस्‍तु को एकाएक और कसकर पकड़ लेना; छीन लेना, झपट लेना)
